WITH equipment_avg AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) as overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
above_avg_equip AS (
  SELECT ea.equipref, ea.avg_humidity, oa.overall_avg
  FROM equipment_avg ea
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ea.avg_humidity > oa.overall_avg
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as group_mean
  FROM above_avg_equip
)
SELECT 
  aae.equipref,
  aae.avg_humidity,
  aae.avg_humidity - aae.overall_avg as exceeds_all_equipment_average,
  aae.avg_humidity - gs.group_mean as difference_from_group_mean
FROM above_avg_equip aae
CROSS JOIN group_stats gs
ORDER BY difference_from_group_mean IS NULL ASC, difference_from_group_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
